settings.title: What is AB and Beyond?
settings.answer: AB and Beyond is the prêt and contemporary line of Achin Bindlish, the New Delhi couture house. It takes the craft of an heirloom couture label into everyday wear: co-ords, blazer sets, shirts and jackets for men and women.

settings.title: How is AB and Beyond different from Achin Bindlish couture?
settings.answer: Achin Bindlish couture is made for weddings and heirloom occasions. AB and Beyond is lighter and ready to wear: modern textiles, fluid shapes, and pieces you can order online and wear the same week.

settings.title: Do you ship outside India?
settings.answer: Yes. Shipping is free on all orders within India, and we deliver worldwide.

settings.title: Can I see the collection in person?
settings.answer: Yes. Visit our studio in Defence Colony, New Delhi, Monday to Saturday, 11 am to 7:30 pm. No appointment is needed.

settings.title: Is checkout secure?
settings.answer: Yes. Every payment goes through an encrypted, secure checkout with full payment protection.

settings.title: How do I reach you?
settings.answer: Call +91 92204 01585 or write to helpdesk@abandbeyond.com. You can also message us on Instagram at @abandbeyond.
